title: Deployment artifacts and production separation have not been proven at the target hosting environment

original_titles.title: D1 deployment artifacts do not exist (compose, Caddy, cloudflared, Pages routing, systemd)
No D1 deployment artifacts (Compose/Caddy/cloudflared) or ARM64 build validation
Ops/content readiness incomplete: runbooks unrehearsed, content not keyed by (stage, repo option), no compose.lock
Cloudflare Access assertion, ADMIN_AUTH_MODE and staging/prod boot refusal missing
practice and integrity schemas absent; role DDL not in migrations

problem: D1 deployment plan is explicitly marked execution UNRUN. The audit notes missing Compose/Caddy/cloudflared/Pages/systemd and ARM64 build validation. GitHub CI validates application code but does not prove the target VM, edge, TLS, firewall, service restart or Cloudflare Access configuration.
impact: A repo that passes CI may still fail to deploy securely or recover under the actual event environment. The same-origin/admin-plane risks and database role separation are not validated in a real deployment.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Create reproducible deployment definitions for API, worker, PostgreSQL, frontend/static hosting and reverse proxy; pin image digests and dependency lockfiles.
Document network boundaries: participant API cannot route to GT DB; admin API is behind access proxy; worker/GT connections have dedicated credentials.
Add health/readiness probes, graceful shutdown, restart policy, resource limits, firewall rules, TLS/HSTS and secret mounts.
Build and test on the target architecture (including ARM64 if that is the production VM), and record package/image provenance.
Perform a clean-host deployment rehearsal, database migration/restore drill, TLS/header scan, admin access test and rollback exercise. Store logs and sign-off.

acceptance_criteria: Fresh deployment works from documented commands without manual hidden steps.
Admin access proxy and DB network isolation are demonstrated from the deployed environment.
Rollback and restore are timed and recorded.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.

residual_risk_or_scope_note: Repository inspection cannot prove Cloudflare, firewall, VM, TLS or production secret settings. These require a real deployment review.
